This international softness contrasts with a domestically resilient US market. US credit conditions show a notable falling 10-year yield at 4.39%, suggesting potentially easing financial conditions despite the unknown BAML HY Spread regime. Equity market breadth remains healthy, with 61.3% of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day moving average (S5FI) and 65.2% above their 200-day moving average (MMTH), indicating broad-based participation.
analysis.analysis_para2: The mechanical plan suggests monitoring key index levels; a hold above 7350 on the S&P 500 would confirm near-term stability, while the Nasdaq 100's strong performance above 29400 indicates tech leadership. Given the normal VIX at 18.89 and healthy breadth, a risk-on approach to proven relative strength leaders is warranted. Traders should prioritize entries near short-term support levels for the highly-rated Hardware and Semiconductor stocks identified by the thematic scanner. Continued falling 10Y yields at 4.39% provide a tailwind for growth-oriented sectors, making follow-through crucial. Watch for confirmation of breadth through S5FI remaining above 60% for sustained buying interest.
